records.name: New standard Ironman immediately after Learning the Ropes
records.scope: A newly created standard Ironman that completes current Tutorial Island/Learning the Ropes, selects Ironman mode before leaving, and has not taken any mainland action.

fixed_possessions.boundary: The 25 coins are initially banked by the tutorial reward. The account-state model treats resources as account-wide, not inventory-slot-specific. The fixture's generic axe and pickaxe keys represent these same bronze tools for generic action predicates; they are not extra physical items.

mandatory_action_xp.resulting_levels: Each listed skill remains level 1. Hitpoints starts at level 10 with 1,154 XP.
variable_or_not_normalized: Melee style and damage during the required giant-rat kill.
Ranged damage during the required giant-rat kill and Magic damage during the required Wind Strike cast on a chicken.
Any extra Tutorial Island training, including optional repeated casts, catches, gathering, cooking, or combat.
mandatory_action_xp.model_boundary: Account snapshots currently store integer XP. The fixture retains only the guaranteed whole-XP values and omits the fixed fractional Smithing and Magic remainder rather than rounding it into a false exact value. This cannot change any resulting starter level.

not_assumed: Mainland Ironman-tutor armour or any other tutor claim.
Adventure Paths, which are unavailable to Ironman accounts.
Any ordinary quest completion in quests_completed.
Any transport flag, achievement-diary tier, passive loop, recurring observation, combat-readiness observation, or loot/drop outcome.
exclusions.reason: Those are either optional mainland interactions, unavailable to this account type, or player-observed progression rather than a mandatory Tutorial Island outcome.
